consent_dm:
Reply Yes to opt in.

If you do, I'll store your non-disappearing group messages in an encrypted database on the host server. I share this text with OpenRouter (Zero Data Retention) only when someone requests a summary or asks me a question.

Summaries and answers are posted in the group for everyone to see.

I never store disappearing messages. You can opt out and delete your data anytime by sending "opt out".

Reply Yes or No (Y/N works too).
consent_clarify:
Just reply Yes or No.
• Yes = opt in
• No = decline

If you say No now, you can still send Yes later to opt in.
opted_in:
You're in.

In the group, @mention me to:
• summarize the past N messages
• status
• dashboard (I'll DM a link)
• opt out
• ask a question

To ask a follow-up, just quote-reply my message (no @mention needed). You can also use this DM to talk to me directly for commnands without mentioning me.
declined:
Got it. I won't collect your messages.

Send Yes here anytime if you change your mind.
opted_out:
Opted out. Your stored messages have been deleted.

Send Yes anytime to opt back in.
unopted_group_notice: You haven't opted in yet, so I can't run commands for you here. Check your DM with me to opt in.

help_text:
@mention me in the group to:
• summarize the past N messages
• status: see your stored message count
• dashboard: get a 1-time login link (expires in 15m)
• opt out: delete your data
• ask anything: I'll use recent chat history if relevant

Quote-reply any of my responses to ask a follow-up without an @mention.
